name: Yu-Para! ~Tadaima Nyuuinchuu~
original_name: ゆ〜パラ！〜ただいま乳院中〜
source:
Kazunari is from a rich family. He is good-looking, smart, and rich, being chased by girls every day. But one day, he has an accident and is hospitalized. Girls think it is a great chance for them to get him! Will he be able to run away from them...? 

[From HimeyaShop]
translation:
一成出身富裕家庭，容貌俊美、头脑聪明又家境优渥，每天都有女孩追在身后。然而某天，他遭遇事故住进医院。女孩们认为，这是接近他的绝佳机会！一成能够从她们手中逃脱吗……？

[摘自HimeyaShop]
